nodes.label: Dual Database Setup (SQLite Dev / MariaDB Prod)
nodes.rationale: SQLite for zero-config dev with StaticPool; MariaDB for production with connection pooling (pool_size=10, max_overflow=20). Export/import scripts bridge environments.
nodes.norm_label: dual database setup (sqlite dev / mariadb prod)

nodes.label: SQLite-backed Rate Limiter (100/60s)
nodes.rationale: SQLite chosen for rate limiter to avoid external dependencies in dev; WAL mode and threading.local() ensure thread safety; skipped in TESTING mode.

nodes.label: Command Pattern (command_it)
nodes.rationale: Wraps functions as command objects with automatic loading/error/result states. Chosen over raw async handlers to centralize loading/error semantics and enable observable UI bindings.

nodes.label: Proxy Pattern (DTO Wrapper)
nodes.rationale: Wraps DTOs with reactive behavior (computed properties, commands, change notification). Override fields enable optimistic UI updates without modifying the underlying DTO.

nodes.label: Pragmatic Flutter Architecture (PFA)
nodes.rationale: Services (external boundaries) + Managers (business logic, NOT ViewModels) + Views (self-responsible UI). Feature-based project structure, not layer-based. Chosen for pragmatic separation without over-engineering.

nodes.label: Manual ARB Localization System
nodes.rationale: Manual ARB loading via rootBundle (no gen-l10n) chosen for full control over 9 locales, nested JSON keys for roles/validation, and runtime locale switching without rebuild.

nodes.label: Singleton + setState + Streams State Mgmt
nodes.rationale: Clakettes uses singletons + StatefulWidget setState() + Streams instead of Provider or flutter_it. Chosen for simplicity in a smaller app with clear service boundaries and SharedPreferences-based persistence.

nodes.label: Operator Chaining Anti-Pattern (memory leak in build())
nodes.rationale: NEVER create operator chains inline in build() because it causes a memory leak by creating a new chain every build. Use class fields or watch_it instead.
nodes.norm_label: operator chaining anti-pattern (memory leak in build())

nodes.norm_label: watch functions (watch, watchit, watchvalue, watchpropertyvalue, watchstream, watchfuture)

nodes.label: The Ordering Rule (watch calls must execute in same order every build)
nodes.rationale: All watch(), registerHandler(), createOnce(), callOnce() calls MUST execute in the same order on every build, like React Hooks, to prevent index mismatches and incorrect rebuilds.
nodes.norm_label: the ordering rule (watch calls must execute in same order every build)

nodes.label: Widget Granularity Rationale
nodes.rationale: A widget watching multiple objects is fine. Only split into smaller WatchingWidgets when watched values change at different frequencies and rebuilds become costly.
